fields.seo_title: Monash University for Indian Students: Fees and Entry 2027
fields.meta_description: Monash University for Indian students: AUD 57,540 a year for 2027 in IT and data science, the visa money to show, IELTS 6.5 and how to apply without an agent.
fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Monash University is a public university in Melbourne, Victoria. Its Clayton campus teaches both courses below. This page uses its two master's courses to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the fee. For a student starting in 2027, each course costs **AUD 57,540** for a full-time year. The visa also needs living money, so the first year costs more than the fee alone.

| | Master of Information Technology | Master of Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| Campus | Clayton, on campus | Clayton, on campus |
| Length | 2 years full time (1.5 years with a cognate degree) | 2 years full time (1.5 years with a cognate degree) |
| Intakes | February and July | February and July |
| Fee for each full-time year, 2027 | **AUD 57,540** | **AUD 57,540** |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, no part below **6.0** | **6.5** overall, no part below **6.0** |
| CRICOS course code | 079055K | 085349A |

CRICOS is the Australian government list of courses that may teach overseas students. Monash lists fees per 48 credit points, which it calls a standard full-time year.

## What it really costs

The fee is only one part of the money. The Australian student visa asks you to show enough money for three things. They are your first-year course fee, 12 months of living costs and your travel. Read the [Australia proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/australia-student-visa-proof-of-funds) for the full rules.

The sums below use the Home Affairs figures: living costs of **AUD 29,710** and travel of **AUD 2,000**. The student visa charge is **AUD 2,500**.

| Item | Master of Information Technology | Master of Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| First-year course fee, 2027 | AUD 57,540 | AUD 57,540 |
| Living costs for 12 months (visa rule) | AUD 29,710 | AUD 29,710 |
| Travel (visa rule) | AUD 2,000 | AUD 2,000 |
| **Money to show for the visa** | **AUD 89,250** | **AUD 89,250** |
| Student visa charge | AUD 2,500 | AUD 2,500 |
| **Total before health cover** | **AUD 91,750** | **AUD 91,750** |

At ₹61.80 per AUD, the totals are **₹56.70 lakh** and **₹56.70 lakh**. The rate is the Reserve Bank of Australia rate for 27 November 2026. It changes every day, so use the [rupee transfer calculator](/study-abroad/tools/rbi-lrs-tcs-calculator) before you send money.

Two limits apply to these totals. Monash gives no fee for later years or for the 1.5 year versions, so we give no whole-course fee. We also found no official price for health cover (OSHC).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Monash's own India page lists the scholarships below. None of them is for a master's course in IT or data science.

- **Engineering International High Achievers Scholarship.** It pays **AUD 15,000** for each 48 credit points of a postgraduate course, towards tuition. There are **25** a year. It is for the Faculty of Engineering only.
- **Monash International Merit Scholarship.** The India page lists it as up to **$50,000** with **31** places a year. The scholarship's own Monash page says it is for students with an undergraduate offer. Monash's two pages disagree. Ask Monash before you count on it.

The India page names three money records the visa accepts. They are a specified annual income, loans from financial institutions and a deposit.

See our [Australia scholarships page](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/scholarships).

## Getting in

Both courses accept a bachelor degree in any subject with at least a credit average, which is **60%**. You can start at entry level 1 and take two years. A cognate degree can shorten the course to 1.5 years. Monash's India page lists the papers to send. They are semester-wise mark sheets, a degree certificate and your own statement of purpose.

**English.** Both courses ask for IELTS **6.5** overall with no part below **6.0**. Monash also accepts Pearson **58** and TOEFL iBT **79**.

**Agent.** Monash says to apply directly. Applicants from a short list of countries must use a registered agent. India is not on that list.

## Deadlines

Monash gives no single closing date. Its international page says application dates vary by faculty and generally open in early August. It says to check closing dates with the faculty. It also says an international student can apply for a place anytime throughout the year.

For mid-year entry, the page says dates generally close in mid-June. Monash's India page says an assessment usually takes **1 to 3 weeks**. Apply early so there is time for the visa.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Information Technology at Monash](/study-abroad/program-detail/australia/monash-university/monash-master-of-information-technology). Two years at Clayton. Open to non-IT graduates.
- [Master of Data Science at Monash](/study-abroad/program-detail/australia/monash-university/monash-master-of-data-science). Two years at Clayton. Open to non-IT graduates.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you hold a bachelor degree with a **60%** average
- you can show AUD 89,250 for the visa
- you want to apply directly, without an agent

**Think carefully if:**

- you want a scholarship for IT or data science, because we found none
- you cannot cover later years at a fee that is not published
- your English score is below IELTS 6.5 overall or 6.0 in any part

## Sources

Checked on 28 November 2026:

- [Master of Information Technology (C6001), Monash University](https://www.monash.edu/study/courses/find-a-course/information-technology-c6001) and its [2027 handbook entry](https://handbook.monash.edu/2027/courses/C6001). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Master of Data Science (C6004), Monash University](https://www.monash.edu/study/courses/find-a-course/data-science-c6004) and its [2027 handbook entry](https://handbook.monash.edu/2027/courses/C6004). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Apply for graduate coursework, international students, Monash University](https://www.monash.edu/admissions/apply/international-pg). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Monash application process for India](https://www.monash.edu/india/study/monash-application-process) and [scholarships and finance options for India](https://www.monash.edu/india/study/scholarships-and-finance-options). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Monash International Merit Scholarship](https://www.monash.edu/study/fees-scholarships/scholarships/find-a-scholarship/international-merit-5770). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Student visa (subclass 500), Department of Home Affairs](https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Exchange rates, Reserve Bank of Australia](https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does a master's at Monash cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For a 2027 start, both the Master of Information Technology and the Master of Data Science cost AUD 57,540 for a full-time year. Monash gives no fee for later years.

faq_json.q: How much money must I show for the Australian student visa to study at Monash?
faq_json.a: For either course the sum is AUD 89,250: the AUD 57,540 fee, AUD 29,710 living costs and AUD 2,000 travel. The visa charge is AUD 2,500 on top.

faq_json.q: Do Indian students need an agent to apply to Monash?
faq_json.a: No. Monash says to apply directly. It asks applicants from a short list of countries to use a registered agent, and India is not on that list.

faq_json.q: What marks do I need for a master's at Monash?
faq_json.a: Both courses ask for at least a credit average, which Monash writes as 60%. Monash accepts a bachelor degree not necessarily in IT.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Monash need for these master's courses?
faq_json.a: IELTS 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0. Monash also accepts Pearson 58 overall or TOEFL iBT 79 overall.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Monash?
faq_json.a: Monash's India page lists an engineering scholarship of AUD 15,000 per 48 credit points, with 25 places a year. We found none for IT or data science.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the 2027 intake at Monash?
faq_json.a: Monash gives no single date. Application dates vary by faculty, so check with the faculty. An international student can apply anytime in the year.
